LanguageData.RRP_SearchTip: Show only resources whose name contains the text. Click again to close the search.
LanguageData.RRP_ModeTip: Showing the {0} list. Click to switch to the {1} list.
LanguageData.RRP_Mode_GroupedTip: Resources sorted into groups you can fold, rename, reorder and add to.
LanguageData.RRP_Mode_SimpleTip: One list of everything, like the base game's simple list.
LanguageData.RRP_MoveIntoItself: A category can't be moved inside itself.
LanguageData.RRP_TipOnMap: On the map: {0} (counting everything, not just storage)
LanguageData.RRP_TipItemHelp: Click to jump to where it is stored, again for the next stack. Drag to move it. Right-click for options.
LanguageData.RRP_TipGroupHelp: Click to open or close. Drag to move it. Right-click for options.
LanguageData.RRP_HistoryOffTip: Turn on trends in the mod settings to record history.
LanguageData.RRP_CountAllTip: Counts every one of this lying on the map (except under fog), not just what is in storage. On a category or group, this applies to everything inside it.
LanguageData.RRP_CountAllInheritedTip: Already counted in full because its category or group is set to count all on the map.
LanguageData.RRP_DeleteGroupConfirm: Delete the group {0}? Everything in it goes back to its usual group.
LanguageData.RRP_OpenSettingsTip: Opens Resource Readout+'s settings: the list, names, width, background opacity, counting, trends and minimum stock.
LanguageData.RRP_MoveGroupIntoItself: A group can't be moved inside itself.
LanguageData.RRP_OrganizeFailed: The organizer hit an error and was closed for this session. The log has the details.
LanguageData.RRP_OrganizeGroupHint: Drag to reorder, use the eye to hide or show, right-click for more.
LanguageData.RRP_OrganizeHiddenHint: Everything you hid. Show any of them again one by one.
LanguageData.RRP_OrganizeEmptyGroup: Nothing is in this group yet. Move resources here from All resources or the readout's right-click menu.
LanguageData.RRP_ShowHideTip: Hidden resources are left out of the readout but can still count towards their group's total.
LanguageData.RRP_MoveToGroupTip: Puts this resource in another group.
LanguageData.RRP_NewGroupTip: Makes a new group at the top level.
LanguageData.RRP_NewSubgroupTip: Makes a new group inside the selected group.
LanguageData.RRP_RenameTip: Renames the selected group. Clearing the name of a built-in group restores its usual name.
LanguageData.RRP_MoveGroupIntoTip: Moves the selected group inside another group.
LanguageData.RRP_MoveToTopTip: Moves the selected group out to the top level.
LanguageData.RRP_GroupUpTip: Moves the selected group above the one before it.
LanguageData.RRP_GroupDownTip: Moves the selected group below the one after it.
LanguageData.RRP_DeleteGroupTip: Deletes a group you made. Its resources go back to their usual groups, and its subgroups move up a level.
LanguageData.RRP_MinimumHint: Below this amount the row turns red and the low stock alert lists it.
LanguageData.RRP_MinimumClearTip: Removes the minimum stock from this row.
LanguageData.RRP_HistoryEmpty: Counts are recorded every hour. Check back later.
LanguageData.RRP_LowStockAlertDesc: These resources are below the minimum stock you set in the resource readout:
LanguageData.RRP_OrganizeHint: Make, rename and nest groups, reorder and hide resources, and show hidden ones again.
LanguageData.RRP_ModeSettingTip: How the readout lists resources. The button on its title bar switches too.
LanguageData.RRP_ShowNamesTip: Shows each resource's name beside its count. Without names the readout is narrower.
LanguageData.RRP_WidthTip: How wide the readout is when it shows names.
LanguageData.RRP_OpacityTip: How solid the readout's background is. Lower values let the map show through.
LanguageData.RRP_ShortNumbersTip: Shows large counts shortened, such as 12.5k instead of 12,500.
LanguageData.RRP_ShowZero: Show resources with a count of zero
LanguageData.RRP_ShowZeroTip: Lists every resource the colony could stock, even ones you have none of. Categories that could never hold anything stay hidden.
LanguageData.RRP_CountHiddenInTotalsTip: Hidden resources still add to their group's or category's total.
LanguageData.RRP_CountCarriedTip: For rows set to count all on the map, also counts what colonists carry and hold in their inventories.
LanguageData.RRP_ClearCountAllTip: Every row goes back to counting only what is in storage.
LanguageData.RRP_TrendsTip: Records every resource's count each hour, saved with the game, and marks rows that went up or down. Needed for the history window.
LanguageData.RRP_TrendHoursTip: The arrows compare the count now with the count this long ago.
LanguageData.RRP_LowStockAlertSettingTip: Shows an alert listing every resource below the minimum stock you set for it. No resource has a minimum until you set one from its right-click menu.
LanguageData.RRP_ClearMinimumsTip: Removes every minimum stock you set.
LanguageData.RRP_ImportHint: Vanilla UI+'s resource order, hidden rows and counting choices were brought over the first time this mod started. Bring them over again here.
LanguageData.RRP_ImportNowTip: Adds Vanilla UI+'s saved resource order, moves, hidden rows and count-all rows to this mod's own.
LanguageData.RRP_ImportNotFound: No Vanilla UI+ settings were found.
LanguageData.RRP_Imported: Vanilla UI+'s resource settings were brought over.
LanguageData.RRP_ImportedNothing: Nothing new to bring over from Vanilla UI+.
LanguageData.RRP_ResetOrderTip: Puts every row of this list back in its usual order and place.
LanguageData.RRP_ResetGroupsTip: Deletes the groups you made and gives the built-in groups their usual names.
LanguageData.RRP_ResetGroupsConfirm: Delete every group you made and restore the usual group names?
LanguageData.RRP_UnpinAllTip: Returns every pinned row to its place.
LanguageData.RRP_ResetFamiliesTip: Combines leathers, wools, stone blocks, fish and eggs again, and shows everything else separately.
